paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
suggested_experiment_name: Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center Axion Search
notes: Neutron star magnetosphere axion-photon conversion search using GBT Breakthrough Listen data. Limit g_agamma ~ 1e-11 GeV^-1 over mass range 15-35 ueV. Exact mass-dependent curve is only shown in Fig. 1 (not numerically tabulated); the emitted points represent the approximate flat exclusion level quoted in abstract/text.
